deviations_from_adr: No new SQL migration. The ADR's three tables (notification 046, email_channel_config 047, notification_preference 048) plus routing/email/templates/REST already exist from sibling tasks T-0168/0169/0170/0171/0173. T-0203's residual gap is the in-app center + per-event settings UI and the one missing HTTP surface (email-channel-config). Reserved migration slot 059 was therefore not used — no schema change is needed.

ChannelDriver carries two optional flags (requiresInAppRow / requiresEmailConfig) above the ADR §2.5 base contract — pre-existing E-N.2 decision in notification-router.ts (documented there), not introduced by T-0203.

Email-config status endpoint added a DELETE verb (revoke) in addition to ADR §2.3's GET/PUT, reusing the already-implemented revokeEmailChannelConfig core CRUD (audit notif.email_config.revoke). Additive, within the §2.3 management surface.
